name: SQLi: boolean differential -> engine errors -> UNION exfil
goal: From a boolean-blind confirmation to engine-fingerprinted error extraction to UNION-based bulk exfiltration.
preconditions: An injectable parameter (string, numeric, ORDER BY, JSON path).
impact: Full database read (and credential harvest feeding auth chains); potential file read depending on engine config.

steps.purpose: Confirm injection with a deterministic differential (AND 1=1 vs 1=2).
Engine fingerprint + version + fast extraction through error messages; swap to PostgreSQL/MSSQL/Oracle siblings per fingerprint.
steps.on_fail: Errors suppressed -> stay time-based and enumerate with the sibling time-based skill.

steps.purpose: Column-count-matched UNION reflection for bulk table dumps.
steps.on_success: Harvest users table -> credentials feed chain auth-bypass-to-admin.
steps.on_fail: Column mismatch resists -> error-based char-by-char extraction; MSSQL -> xp_cmdshell (documented variant, needs privilege).

entry_points: ORDER BY / LIMIT / OFFSET parameters (classic blind spot)

recon.name: Param classification
recon.how: Test numeric vs string vs ORDER BY contexts with minimal toggles (' vs " vs ') before any payload.

recon.name: Error fragment mining
recon.how: Tracebacks with SQL fragments give engine, table and even the query — selects the right skill instantly.

recon.name: Second-order candidate list
recon.how: Mark stored fields (profile, filenames) as delayed injection surfaces — they hit SQL in background jobs.
recon.signal: Stored value later reflected in SQL-driven error.

recon.name: Encoding quirks
recon.how: URL-encoding vs raw, unicode tricks, comment variants (--, #, /**/) change filter behavior.
recon.signal: One encoding passes where others fail.

recon.name: GraphQL argument injection
recon.how: GraphQL resolvers often build SQL from string args — inject inside query strings.

pivot_hints: MySQL FILE privilege -> secure_file_priv file read
database names -> data_stores shelf sweep for direct connections
